name: Liberty Steel and Welding LLC
headline: Kandas, your trusted partner for Workforce Solutions
lede: Kandas Group - your one-stop solution for finding & hiring qualified technical workforce solutions for your technical projects in the Middle East & UAE.
about: With a focus on meeting clients’ project needs, Kandas offers various fabrication services tailored to each project. With more than 15 years of experience outsourcing fabricators to leading industries in the U.A.E. and Middle East, we possess a strong understanding of the required skillset and project timelines.

Hiring technical labour can be tedious and time-consuming, especially in a region where construction is constant and ripe with demand. With our construction staffing solutions, clients will obtain the correct technical candidate to complete the task. Our construction staffing solutions have helped companies across the U.A.E. and the Middle East meet various staffing requirements on time and within their budget.
